decisions: Parse the actual generated Workbox precacheAndRoute array rather than scanning dist, so the budget follows what the service worker really caches.
Use 25 MiB (25*1024*1024 bytes) for the documented 25 MB budget, consistent with pwaOptions.maximumFileSizeToCacheInBytes.

Prove the waiting-update path by changing real service-worker bytes at the same URL, then assert waiting state, zero controllerchange, and Later leaving it waiting; restore the original file in finally.
Start every PWA test from an empty browser context so the demo seeds through the real IndexedDB path; pre-set only the hint-seen marker.
interfaces: scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs exports DEFAULT_PRECACHE_BUDGET_BYTES, DEFAULT_SW_PATH, parsePrecacheManifest, computePrecacheBudget, formatPrecacheBudgetReport, parseArguments, and main.
e2e/pwa.spec.ts defines separate installability, offline reload/OCR, and waiting-update journeys.

payload.taskDescription: Add e2e/pwa.spec.ts to load the production preview, assert manifest and icons, wait for service-worker control, switch the context offline, reload the app shell, verify the shelf and demo case still render, and confirm the OCR worker, wasm, and traineddata URLs are present in the service-worker cache. Collect all runtime requests and fail on any non-same-origin request. Add scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs to read the service-worker precache manifest and fail above 25 MB, and tests/release/bundleBudget.test.ts for its parser. Do not add the human review.
